families.trigger: local external impulse exceeds threshold
families.update: store impulse direction; set echo=1; decay echo
families.action: bias movement toward push_dir by echo
families.failure: repeated shoves can cause compulsive backtracking

families.trigger: local support drops from nonzero to zero
families.update: store travel direction; set fear=1; decay while supported
families.action: bias movement opposite danger_dir by fear
families.failure: narrow ledges can cause oscillatory indecision

families.trigger: commanded motion is high but local displacement stays low
families.update: accumulate jam; advance phase; reset after free motion
families.action: reverse then turn then jump once by phase
families.failure: soft obstacles can retrigger the ritual

families.trigger: local collision impulse exceeds threshold
families.update: set freeze from impulse; decay during quiet contact
families.action: suppress movement and turning by freeze
families.failure: persistent jostling can lock the actor

families.trigger: local wheel slip exceeds threshold
families.update: store slip side; set avoidance; decay with traction
families.action: steer away from slip_side by avoidance
families.failure: alternating slip can create weaving

families.trigger: local crossing motion enters forward sensor arc
families.update: increase charge; set refractory after jump; decay refractory
families.action: jump when charged and refractory is zero
families.failure: periodic machinery can entrain pounces

families.trigger: nearby impact sound exceeds threshold
families.update: store direction away; raise panic; decay in quiet
families.action: move along threat_dir by panic
families.failure: harmless impacts can herd the actor

families.trigger: local forward progress stalls at same frontal contact
families.update: increase stubborn to cap; decay after free motion
families.action: increase bounded forward force by stubborn
families.failure: immovable walls can waste effort

families.trigger: local vertical velocity changes sign outside deadband
families.update: store error; set damped opposite correction
families.action: apply vertical thrust from correction
families.failure: sensor noise can sustain oscillation

families.trigger: local angular speed exceeds threshold
families.update: store spin sign; set grudge=1; decay grudge
families.action: apply counter-torque opposite spin_sign
families.failure: alternating hits can cause twitching

families.trigger: local resource pickup succeeds
families.update: store pickup direction; set scent=1; decay scent
families.action: when idle bias movement along return_dir
families.failure: depleted patches can attract revisits

families.trigger: opposed local side contacts indicate narrow passage
families.update: store compression axis; set memory=1; decay by distance
families.action: reduce lateral posture along squeeze_axis
families.failure: stale memory can keep posture too narrow

families.trigger: hard local landing follows airborne state
families.update: set ready on landing; clear on use or support loss
families.action: perform one bounded rebound hop when ready
families.failure: bumpy contacts can look like stuttering

families.trigger: local uphill motion succeeds above speed threshold
families.update: store uphill direction; raise confidence; decay on flat
families.action: bias tilt and drive toward similar local slope
families.failure: abrupt terrain changes can cause wrong lean

families.trigger: local velocity direction changes without matching command
families.state: expected_dir unit vector; confidence 0..1; probe_side bit
families.update: lower confidence; toggle probe_side; recover on stable motion
families.action: slow and alternate small probe turns
families.failure: rough terrain can sustain cautious probing

families.trigger: local lateral contact impulse occurs
families.update: count repeated same-side bumps; reset on timeout or action
families.action: turn away once when bump_count reaches three
families.failure: wall vibration can cause periodic turns

families.trigger: nearby local collision sound occurs
families.update: store move direction; set pause_ticks=2; decrement
families.action: wait while paused then resume saved_dir
families.failure: dense collisions can keep resetting pause

families.trigger: speed rises on a locally sensed downhill slope
families.update: store downhill direction; raise excitement; decay off descent
families.action: bias steering toward matching local descent
families.failure: fast drops can become overpreferred

families.trigger: local deformation rate exceeds threshold
families.update: store stretch direction; set resistance=1; decay
families.action: bias contraction against stretch_dir
families.failure: repeated impacts can make the blob temporarily rigid

families.trigger: local heat gradient exceeds threshold
families.update: store heat direction; set memory=1; decay without gradient
families.action: bias movement along warm_dir by memory
families.failure: stale heat memory can lead into cold space

families.trigger: local traction is lost during a turn
families.update: store turn side; raise caution; decay with stable traction
families.action: reduce turning toward bad_turn by caution
families.failure: slippery corners can make steering timid

families.trigger: local landing impulse exceeds threshold
families.update: set shy=1; decay during supported ticks
families.action: suppress jump while shy is high
families.failure: rough ground can suppress jumping repeatedly

families.trigger: forward progress stalls at a local obstacle
families.update: choose side from local clearance; set attempts=2; decrement
families.action: turn toward escape_side while attempts remain
families.failure: moving obstacles can stale the remembered side

families.trigger: local startle event occurs
families.update: store event direction; set vigilance=1; decay
families.action: periodically face startle_dir while vigilant
families.failure: harmless startles can distract travel

families.trigger: sustained local lateral surface contact
families.update: store contact side; increase trace; decay off surface
families.action: curve toward remembered contact_side by trace
families.failure: one brush can cause obstacle orbiting

families.trigger: one local foot loses support while another remains planted
families.update: store failed side; set caution=3; decrement after stable step
families.action: widen the step on weak_side while cautious
families.failure: alternating slips can keep gait inefficiently wide

families.trigger: local flash event occurs
families.update: increment count; store flash_dir; clear after action
families.action: on count four turn toward flash_dir once
families.failure: regular machinery can repeatedly steal attention

families.trigger: local luminance drops faster than threshold
families.update: store travel direction; set hold=1; decay when light stabilizes
families.action: stop while held then resume along resume_dir
families.failure: flickering lights can repeatedly freeze motion
